method: Direct inspection of complete original image via view_image detail=original. Coordinator review, not a blinded comparative experiment. No assumed off-frame continuity.

observations.evidence: Masonry sides and a recognizable stone arch frame the nursery opening behind the repair.

One unbroken ribbed organic lining follows the visible doorway edge and reaches the folded tissue junction. The source does not require a complete 360-degree perimeter; the additional authored full-arch frame is checked separately.
A pliable folded organic junction is visible at the lower right doorway edge beside the root, distinct from the ribbed stone.
The visible ribbed lining follows the masonry doorway edge. This local relation does not prove the cropped complete path.
At the right edge the lining visibly flows into the pliable folded junction without a local gap. Its biological function or actual motion is not proved.
Dark bob, wispy fringe and the reference-like face impression remain visible in a new practical-armour scene; identity is not established.
The upper hand touches the upper scute rim and the lower hand supports its lower edge, with the central scute face visible.

Two separate raised strands are apparent between forearm armour and the scute region, and their terminal junctions are partly hidden by the plate/hand. The exact single continuous cord requirement is not established.
Amber capillary-like branches spread from the held scute toward the split bark; a nursery tray and leaking water are co-visible.
The arch crown extends outside the frame. The pre-render plan requires the complete small doorway and exposed arch/right-jamb path together, which is not established.

strict_M08_basis: All five source components/relations are visible locally. Separately, the authored pre-render full-doorway frame condition is incomplete; it is not silently weakened and the whole case still fails.
limits: This is actual use of one new source, not proof for the other 67 visual options.
No generated before-data baseline exists, so no causal improvement claim.
Breathing, digestion, learning, graft success and impending flood sequence are not proved by still pixels.
The initial registration pixel_status belongs to its immutable source version; this separate source-hash-bound evidence records the later experiment.
review_scope_clarification: Source-local geometry and the stronger composed full-frame requirement are distinct. Initial coordinator reading combined them; this final review separates them while preserving the strict whole-case failure.
